question: VAT rises from 20% to 22%. A jacket costs €120 including VAT. What is its new price, in euros?
move: A tax on top of a price moves the price less than the rate.
ask: When a tax I pay goes up, do I work out the real change in my bill before reacting?
trap: Adding 10% to €120, because the tax rate rose by a tenth.
hint: First take the VAT out of €120 to find the price before tax.
reference: Blastland & Dilnot, The Tiger That Isn't: Seeing Through a World of Numbers, Profile Books, 2007
